verdict.rationale: Pulumi's Automation API is documented as a programmatic interface for running Pulumi programs without the CLI. It uses the engine as an SDK to create, update, configure, and destroy infrastructure from application code, and lets you build custom cloud interfaces. An independent user also reports using Automation API to code infrastructure migrations. Missing for 10: detailed evidence of per-language Automation API coverage and of specific preview/up operations, plus deeper hands-on corroboration.
